約書亞樂團
詞曲 / Abbie Gamboa, Josiah Funderburk, Zac Rowe
中譯詞 / 吳芳儀、周巽光

lines.a: 我是敬拜器皿 尊崇讚美祢
lines.b: I am an instrument of exaltation

lines.a: 受造為了高舉祢名超乎萬名
lines.b: And I was born to lift Your name above all names

lines.a: 祢聽萬物宣揚 歌唱的旋律
lines.b: You hear the melody of all creation

lines.a: 但有首歌只有我能獻上給祢
lines.b: But there's a song of praise that only I can bring
Who else is worthy
Who else is worthy

lines.a: 無人配得 只有祢耶穌
lines.b: There is no one, only You Jesus
Who else is worthy
Who else is worthy

lines.a: 無人配得 只有祢耶穌
lines.b: There is no one, only You Jesus

lines.a: 祢是世世代代 永恆的上帝
lines.b: You are the infinite God of the ages

lines.a: 祢卻選擇我心為祢所在之地
lines.b: Yet You chose to make my heart Your dwelling place

lines.a: 醫治我的破碎 祢榮耀顯明
lines.b: You healed my brokenness, showed me Your glory

lines.a: 天使無法像我獻上感恩的心
lines.b: So I have songs of thanks not even angels sing
Lamb of God anointed one
Who was and is and is to come
Seated on the throne above
Holy, Holy
Righteous one who shed His blood
To prove to us the Father's love
Jesus Christ be lifted up
